newsitem.title: UK: Britons leave $122 billion unclaimed - report.
newsitem.headline: Britons leave $122 billion unclaimed - report.

text.p: Britons have left unclaimed a staggering 77 billion pounds ($122 billion) worth of forgotten fortunes in bank accounts and shares, a market survey showed Tuesday.
This would be enough to pay the income tax of everyone in the country for a year or release sufficient funds to build seven more Channel tunnels between France and Britain.

The Mintel survey showed that Britons have lost track of almost 55 billion pounds ($87 billion) saved with banks, building societies, national savings and in stocks and shares. Many flotation benefits have never been claimed.

Over 22 billion pounds ($35 billion) are waiting to be claimed from the National Lottery, bookmakers and company benefits like pension entitlements, Mintel said in its survey conducted for independent financial advisers.
